coverage_notes: Bounded supplementary recall watch completed with 12 targeted fresh web searches. Coverage focused on loss/fire/closure of only, sole, last, or full-service grocery stores; canceled or suspended emergency food distributions caused by storm, flood, fire, outage, or facility damage; abrupt pantry/food-bank service closure or major access reduction; and official SNAP/WIC interruptions with immediate access consequences. No new qualifying signal was identified since the prior hourly check. Older/recycled items, routine pantry operations, donation/resource content, and unrelated closures were excluded. California WIC app maintenance scheduled for September 26 was excluded because participants can still use benefits at stores and alternative benefit-balance methods remain available.
